summary: The stored rating rests on one small trial reporting change from baseline (21490917). A Cochrane review finds randomized evidence does not support lecithin in dementia (12917896). A double-blind trial in hyperlipidaemic men found no independent lipid effect (9683394), and an emulsifier trial found no cholesterol difference (40816342). Positive results are within-group (21490917, 17006376), secondary (15662899), one scale among several (29310653), or a non-randomized acute stroke study (16200721). All this is soy or unspecified lecithin; no sunflower lecithin trial was found, and 6 of 33 labels print it.
